entities.summary: Tchiss Lopes (b. 1959-07-27, São Vicente) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in São Vicente and Cape Verde. Known in the fields of cape verde, composers & musicians, africa.
